catalyst_text: Announced dose ranging cohort initiation and positive data
detailed_catalyst_text: A new dose-ranging cohort was initiated within the ongoing Phase 1/2 study in adults with Familial Adenomatous Polyposis. Early clinical observations in FAP patients with concomitant desmoid tumors showed significant reductions in duodenal polyp burden with a favorable safety profile. These updates strengthen evidence for activity in FAP and help inform dose and schedule selection.
catalyst_text_evidence: Parabilis Medicines (Nasdaq: PBLS) ... today announced the initiation of a dose-ranging clinical cohort evaluating zolucatetide in patients with familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP) as part of the company’s ongoing Phase 1/2 clinical trial. Early clinical proof-of-concept data reported to date from patients with FAP and concomitant desmoid tumors enrolled in the ongoing Phase 1/2 trial support the therapeutic potential of zolucatetide in FAP. In two patients who underwent routine endoscopic evaluation while receiving zolucatetide, significant reductions in polyp burden were observed, from Spigelman Stage IV to a near-normal duodenum and from Spigelman Stage II to Stage I, respectively. Zolucatetide has demonstrated a favorable safety and tolerability profile to date.
